text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
At last, preparations for Operation:
Behold
Windy's Might are complete!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You know what they say! "Prank while
the iron's
hot"! We're putting this into
action today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Our target is none other than Hishiama!
The
terrifying Demon Lord Windy's
gonna strike fear
into her heart!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet! Let's get her totally spooked, Your

Scariness! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But isn't today the day
Hishiama's—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Your Scariness, the camera is in position
and
ready to go! I've made sure the
angle is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hype Crew
text_block_list.text:
Wahey-heeey! ☆ The Runaway Besties
called us
in, so here we aaare!

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Tanuki, you came! And wow, so
many of
Palmer and Helios's friends
came too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Hishiama should be back any
minute!
Remember everyone—all
together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hishiama, I bought the latest Twinkle Monthly! Your expression on the front cover gave me legit goosebumps—it was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And your interview was amazing! Your 
appreciation for the final stretch, your
love for one-on-ones... They just get me
every time I read
it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you're gonna make me blush! I
knew going in how popular the magazine
is, so I just put in
some extra effort to
not embarrass myself, is all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well,
well! If it isn't Hishiama! Feast your
eyes on
this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
La, la, la! Wasshoi, wasshoi! ♪ We've got
you
surrounded, Hishiama! ♪

text_block_list.name: Doto and Mr. Tanuki
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi, wasshoi! ♪ Mr. Tanuki just
woke up, but
h-he's... going to dance
too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eheheh. Hehehe. So... precious...

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! Wahey! ☆ Let's get these vibes
up! ♪
You're in for a shock, Hishiama! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
La, la, la! Check it out! ♪ This is my big
plan in
action! ♪

text_block_list.name: Flash Mob
text_block_list.text: Hi-shi-a-ma! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on?! Why are you all
dancing?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You've got shocked written all
over you!
Do you finally comprehend the
magnitude of my
greatness?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Shocked? More like overwhelmed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I just... I can't believe it.
I had no idea you were
going to throw me such a big
celebration for my
magazine feature!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I only realized it just earlier
myself. Who would've guessed that this
wasn't a prank, but a
surprise
celebration?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Windy... You must really care
about
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, for real?! Going above and
beyond for your favorite person... It's
gotta be that thing Digital was telling
me about, right? That
"tsundere" thing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hwhhgnf! Intentional or not, this is so...
so
PRECIOUS! I'm so blessed! Thank you,
thank you,
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you all grinning at me for?!

Hishiama's supposed to be quaking in
fear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dammit, here come the waterworks.
Thank
you so much, Windy. I'll do my
best to get
featured in a magazine again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This isn't how things were supposed to
goooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a sea of smiles, Shinko
Windy
despairs at just how sideways her
perfect prank
went.
